title: How To Make Infrared Cooling Paint (Electricity Free Air Conditioning)
summary: NightHawkInLight shows how to make ultra-white radiative paint that cools surfaces below ambient temperature without electricity. He walks through the research papers and the household-materials process.
why: HN points to it as a practical, well-researched DIY demonstration of passive radiative cooling.

quote.text: This YouTuber[0] does an excellent job recreating chemistry research from papers and improving on the techniques to be accomplished with household materials.
